name: 11703 · North Babylon, NY
findings: ZIP 11703 (North Babylon) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11703 (North Babylon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
